tags.feature: - Added Fyodora - specializes in shotguns, HP, and frost damage!

tags.balance_change: - Chuck - removed Weakpoint upgrade, added Retail Therapy
- Gosling - removed Reverse Speed upgrade, added Weakpoint

tags.feature: - Added the "Convert Currency" panel to the garage
- Allows the player to convert scrap to cash and vice versa
- New upgrade: "Celebratory Feast" - increases HP regained on level-up
- New upgrade: "Tortoise Shell" - all armor applied to BACK only
- New upgrade: "Pacifist" - weapon deals +100% damage, but can no longer kill or deal elemental dmg
- New upgrade: "Backhoe" - Deal plow and building damage while reversing

tags.balance_change: - "Fat Reserves": armor effectiveness changed from 0% -> 50%
- "Booze Cruise": accuracy penalty changed from 50% -> 25%
- Accuracy previously only affected a weapon's spread, which became insignificant once large swarms of enemies appeared
- When dealing damage, weapons now have a chance to deal a "glancing blow," which reduces damage by 50%
- Glancing blow chance on hit = (1 - Weapon Accuracy)
- For example, a weapon with 75% accuracy will deal a glancing blow 25% of the time
- Accuracy still affects weapon spread, but shotguns now have a minimum spread amount

tags.feature: - New modifier: "Piercing Blows" - Increases enemy armor piercing damage
- New modifier: "Special Forces" - increases elite enemy spawn rate
- Removed modifiers that spawned specific elite enemies
- Explosions and shrapnel now create elemental effects
- Damage numbers now create more vertical separation between each other to make them more legible
- Minimap now shows the location of enemy shield generators
- Added a bulldozer animation in the loading screen

tags.balance_change: - Driller move speed increased from 1.5 m/s -> 2 m/s
- Elite enemies now move 25% faster
- Elite enemies now have a chance to spawn at any time, with the spawn rate and max elite count increasing at higher levels
- Hunting rifle: increased fire rate
- Javelin: increased accuracy

tags.feature: - Updated projectile sprites for crossbow, explosive crossbow, and javelin

tags.balance_change: - Buildings now drop 10% less scrap
- Destroying a non-target building now removes 5 seconds from the clock
- Armor base scrap cost changed from 10 -> 15

tags.feature: Added Bucky, the Kamikaze Cockerel!
Specializes in explosive weapons
New upgrade: "Stopping Power" - increased weapon knockback
New upgrade: "Retail Therapy" - coins restore HP
Elemental upgrades (e.g. Hailstorm, Short Circuit, etc.) will now only appear if the player has a weapon with the relevant element
Added the Hardware Store building type, which drops large amounts of wood
Reworked the map generation algorithm to better distribute special locations (Armory, Black Market, etc.) throughout the map
Wood collectibles now travel to the player portrait when collected
Added trail effects for projectiles with elemental upgrades
While in a mission, the cursor will disappear if not moved for 1 second

tags.bug: Fixed a bug preventing Shotgunners from spawning

tags.balance_change: Increased HP for elite enemies
Reduced Hacker frequency
Revolvers now reload one bullet at a time (total reload time remains the same)
Shrapnel now travels at a fixed speed instead of being tied to the parent projectile's speed

tags.bug: Fixed an issue with shrapnel playing the parent weapon's sound effect
